worldcombat.skill.acupressure.summary: Press one pressure point: among the stats the body is not yet maxed on, one is rolled at random and raised sharply. The only member of its group with a random result and the only one that can be applied to a partner; a steady press is stronger and slower, a quick press is instant and always available. The rolled stat comes back when the window ends.
worldcombat.skill.acupressure.use.0: Fill in one stat at random and push a lopsided body toward a better shape
worldcombat.skill.acupressure.use.1: Press up the one stat a partner lacks most
worldcombat.skill.acupressure.use.2: Quick-press through a long trade, steady-press to top off when it matters
worldcombat.skill.acupressure.descriptio: Acupressure raises one random stat by %1$s stages (only stats not yet at +6).
worldcombat.skill.acupressure.steady.on: Steady press: +3 stages, but 5 ticks more telegraph and cooldown ×1.3, good for topping off in one go.
worldcombat.skill.acupressure.steady.off: Quick press: +2 stages, near-instant with a shorter cooldown, good for frequent touch-ups; each has its moment.
worldcombat.skill.acupressure.descriptio: The point is within %1$s blocks and the flow lasts about %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.acupressure.timing: Ally move (self or partner), range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.acupressure.growth.0: At level %1$s the flow lasts %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.acupressure.growth.1: At level %1$s the flow reaches %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.acupressure.preference: On: steady press, +3 stages, 5 ticks more telegraph and cooldown ×1.3. Off: quick press, +2 stages, near-instant with a shorter cooldown.
